description: Apply scrapbook visual redesign to JournalEditorPage.vue: denim-blue graph-paper background, handwritten title font, two-page desktop spread with center binding, cream notebook pages, Polaroid-style photo frames with washi tape, and pastel decorative details. This implements the visible UI transformation that the user reported was missing.
steps: 1. Add handwritten Google Fonts (Indie Flower, Patrick Hand, Crimson Text, Merriweather) to c:\Users\Juan Miguel\Cronevia\frontend\index.html by replacing the existing Google Fonts link on line 9

2. Transform root background in JournalEditorPage.vue from beige (#f5ebdd) to denim-blue (#2C4054) with graph paper pattern overlay (repeating-linear-gradient for white grid lines at 20px intervals with 30% opacity)
3. Replace sticky header (lines 529-552) with notebook-style header: background #3a4f61, border-bottom #1a2634, burgundy save button with shadow

4. Replace form container (lines 555-556) with two-page desktop spread: hidden md:grid md:grid-cols-2, cream pages #F5F1E8, binding shadows (gradient-to-l from-black/10 on left page right edge, gradient-to-r from-black/10 on right page left edge), min-height 800px
5. Add mobile single-page layout: md:hidden single cream page with rounded corners, shadow-2xl, min-height 600px, all content stacked vertically
6. Apply handwritten title styling: font-family 'Indie Flower' or 'Patrick Hand', font-size 2rem, bg-transparent, border-none, text-#2b1a10
7. Add compact metadata badges row after title: date badge, mood badge (if set), location badge (if set) - each with icon, text, rounded-full, bg-#fdfaf5, border-#d7c7b3, flex-wrap, text-xs
8. Style content textarea with readable serif: font-family 'Crimson Text' or 'Merriweather', line-height 1.8, text-base, bg-transparent with border, min-height 300px

9. Wrap PhotoUpload component with Polaroid styling div and add scoped CSS: .photo-preview with white bg, padding 12px 12px 48px 12px, box-shadow, rotate(-2deg) alternating with rotate(2deg), ::before pseudo-element for washi tape (pink gradient, top -8px, width 60%, height 20px)

10. Add scoped CSS for notebook page inset shadow, Polaroid frames, washi tape decoration, and pastel corner embellishment (::after pseudo-element with ✦ symbol, top-right corner, rgba(255,182,193,0.4))
acceptance_criteria: Denim-blue graph-paper background is visible on the journal editor page
Handwritten font (Indie Flower or Patrick Hand) is applied to entry title
Desktop shows a two-page spread with visible center binding shadow
Mobile shows a single stacked cream page
Content uses readable serif font (Crimson Text or Merriweather)
Photos display with Polaroid-style white frames and pink washi tape decoration
Date, mood, and location appear as compact rounded badges with icons
Pastel decorative details (corner sparkle) are visible
verification: cd c:\Users\Juan Miguel\Cronevia\frontend && npm run build (must succeed with no TypeScript errors)
Visual check: background is denim blue with graph paper pattern (not beige)
Visual check: title input uses handwritten font
Visual check (desktop): two cream pages side-by-side with center shadow
Visual check (mobile, resize to <768px): single stacked cream page
Visual check: content textarea uses serif font
Add a photo: verify Polaroid white frame with pink washi tape at top
Visual check: pastel sparkle (✦) in top-right corner of page
findings: Successfully implemented scrapbook visual redesign. Key findings: (1) There were TWO JournalEditorPage.vue files - one in backend/resources/js/pages/ (unused Laravel remnant) and one in frontend/src/pages/ (actual Vue 3 app). Modified the correct frontend file. (2) Added Google Fonts (Indie Flower, Patrick Hand, Crimson Text, Merriweather) to index.html. (3) Transformed background to denim-blue #2C4054 with CSS graph-paper pattern. (4) Created two-page desktop spread with center binding shadows and single-page mobile layout. (5) Applied handwritten font to title and serif font to content. (6) Added metadata badges with clear buttons for mood and location. (7) Added Polaroid photo frame styling with washi tape via scoped CSS. (8) Added pastel corner sparkle decoration. Build completed successfully with no TypeScript errors.
